steps.body: Each digit after the point has its own place name: first the tenths place, then the hundredths place.
steps.narration: Each digit after the point has its own place name: first the tenths place, then the hundredths place.

widget.prompt: Shade the grid to show 0.58. Each full column is one tenth; each cell is one hundredth.

commonCounts.feedback: That shades only 8 single cells. The tenths digit of 0.58 is worth whole columns: 5 full columns first, then 8 more cells.
That count swaps the digits of 0.58. The first digit after the point counts full columns; the second counts single cells.

widget.successFeedback: Exactly 58 of the 100 cells — 5 full columns and 8 more cells: 58 hundredths, written 0.58.
widget.lowFeedback: The shaded amount is still below the target. Fill whole columns for the tenths digit first, then single cells for the hundredths.
widget.highFeedback: The shaded amount has gone past the target. Each full column is one tenth — check the tenths digit before adding single cells.

predict.prompt: In the decimal 0.58, which place does the digit 5 occupy?
predict.reveal: Reading outward from the point, the first place is tenths: the 5 in 0.58 is 5 tenths — five full columns of the grid. The next place right is hundredths — the 8 is 8 hundredths — and each step right names pieces ten times smaller.

widget.prompt: In the decimal 0.58, which place does the digit 5 occupy?

options.label: hundredths
options.feedback: The hundredths place of 0.58 holds the digit 8. Read outward from the decimal point: tenths first, then hundredths.

options.label: ones
options.feedback: The ones place sits to the LEFT of the decimal point, and in 0.58 it holds 0. The digit 5 sits after the point, among the decimal places.

options.label: tens
options.feedback: The tens place is two positions left of the decimal point — this number has no digit there at all. The digit 5 sits after the point, among the decimal places.

options.label: tenths
options.feedback: Correct — reading left from the decimal point, 0.58 has 5 in the tenths place and 8 in the hundredths place, so the 5 is in the tenths place.

hints: First place after the point is tenths.
The 5 is in the tenths place.
